info.name: Customer Portal - Mr Storage
info.description:
All Customer Portal APIs — Mr Storage Backend

Base URL: https://mr-storage-backend-1.onrender.com/api
Local URL: http://localhost:5001/api

Test credentials:
  email: customer1@example.com
  password: Test@1234

Flow: Run Login first → token auto-saved → all requests work.

variable.description: Auto-set by Get Upcoming Deliveries request

request.description: Returns accessToken + refreshToken. Test script auto-saves token to {{customerToken}}.
Returns: firstName, lastName, email, phone, photo, customerId, createdAt

Returns: activeProjects, closedProjects, drawingsAndApprovals, deliveryTracking { inTransit, staged, ready, totalToday, upcomingDeliveries, deliveriesThisWeek, delayedDeliveries, rescheduledDeliveries }, shipmentBreakdown, nextDelivery, totalProjectValue, totalPaid, totalPending, upcomingInvoice

Returns projects list + stats cards (matches Figma):

stats:
  total         → Total Projects card
  active        → Active Projects card  (plant stages: released_to_plant → dispatched)
  workInProgress → Work in Progress card (sales stages: initial_contact → sent_to_admin)
  cancelled     → Canceled card          (isTerminated: true)

Each project: _id, projectName, jobId, lifecycleStatus, location, buildingType, quoteValue

Test data:
  PRO-001 warehouse - Texas    (fabrication_started)  ← leadId default
  PRO-002 office - Bangalore   (quality_inspection)
  PRO-011 (initial_contact)    [cancelled]

Returns: lead, quotation, quoteSummary, invoices[], paymentSchedule, navigation

navigation { previous, next } — sibling project { _id, jobId, projectName } in the customer's project list (same order as Get All Projects), for the prev/next project switcher button. null at either end of the list.

Returns the RFQ (Request for Quotation) details:
  rfq { jobId, projectName, buildingType, roofStyle, sqft, width, length, location, description, quoteValue, isQuoteReady, lifecycleStatus, aiSummary, aiQuoteData }
  quotation (latest Quotation doc or null)

Mock data (PRO-001):
  buildingType: warehouse
  roofStyle: gable
  sqft: 6000
  width: 60, length: 120
  quoteValue: 250000
  isQuoteReady: true

request.description:
Update building specs before quote is locked.

Allowed fields: buildingType, roofStyle, sqft, width, length, location, description

Locked (returns 400) if lifecycleStatus is:
  deal_closed | payment_done | converted_to_po | sent_to_admin | released_to_plant

Cancels a project (sets isTerminated: true).

Rules:
  - reason is required
  - Cannot cancel if already cancelled
  - Cannot cancel if lifecycleStatus is 'delivered'

Reflected in GET /projects → stats.cancelled count.

request.description: Creates a new project enquiry (lead) for this customer. Sets lifecycleStatus: initial_contact.

query.description: architectural | structural | fabrication | erection | specification | other

request.description:
Returns:
  drawings[]        — DrawingDocument records (with status, revisionNote, fileUrl)
  embeddedDocuments[] — from lead.documents array
  total

Test script auto-saves first drawing _id to {{docId}}.

Mock data (PRO-001):
  Foundation Plan Rev A   (architectural, approved)
  Structural Steel Layout (structural,   approved)
  Roof Panel Layout       (architectural, approved)
  Electrical Plan         (other,         under_review)
  Site Elevation          (other,         approved)

Statuses: pending | approved | rejected | under_review

Customer approves a drawing.

Sets status → approved, approvedAt → now.
Returns: { _id, name, status }

Run 'Get Project Drawings' first to populate {{docId}}.

Customer requests a revision on a drawing.

Sets status → under_review, saves revisionNote + revisionRequestedAt.
note is required.
Returns: { _id, name, status, revisionNote }

Returns the latest Quotation document for this project (quotation tab detail view).

Returns 404 if no quotation has been created for this project yet.

status: draft | sent | accepted | rejected

Returns paginated AuditLog records for this project.
  activity[] { type, action, performedBy{name,role}, metadata, createdAt }
  total, page, limit

Mock data (PRO-001): 28 audit log entries
  lead.released_to_plant, invoice.created, drawing.approved, etc.

Returns:
  notes[]      — lead.leadNotes array { note, addedAt, addedBy }
  generalNotes — lead.notes string
  total

Mock data (PRO-001):
  'Customer confirmed site ready for foundation work'
  'Structural drawings approved by client on call'
  'Color selection: Galvalume Silver exterior panels'

Returns:
  followUps[] { followUpDate, modeOfContact, notes, status, assignedTo{name,email} }
  total, page, limit
  stats { total, pending, completed }

modeOfContact values: phone | email | video_call | in_person

  ✅ Engineering review — BOM approval        (completed, email)

Returns:
  meetings[] { title, meetingTime, mode, meetingLink, status, createdBy{name,email} }
  total, page, limit
  stats { total, scheduled, completed, cancelled }

mode values: online | offline

request.description:
Returns all documents across all customer projects grouped by project.
Includes both DrawingDocument collection records AND embedded lead.documents.

Response: projects[{ lead{jobId,projectName,...}, documents[], count }], totalDocuments

Mock data: 8 total drawings (5 for PRO-001, 3 for PRO-002)

Filters to DrawingDocument records only.
Mock data: 8 drawings across 2 projects
  PRO-001: Foundation Plan, Structural Steel, Roof Panel, Electrical Plan, Site Elevation
  PRO-002: Office Floor Plan, Structural Frame, MEP Schematic

tab values: upcoming | past | rescheduled

Returns: deliveries[], total, tabs{upcoming, past, rescheduled counts}
Each delivery: deliveryId, deliveryNumber, status, description, deliveryDate, loadWeight, siteContact{name,phone}, deliveryCompany{name,contact,phone}, loadAndBundle{loadId, bundleCount, truckNumber, totalWeight}, project{jobId,projectName}

Test script auto-saves first delivery's _id to {{deliveryId}}.

  CUST-DEL-002  in_transit   Secondary panels - Roof and wall cladding (2026-07-30)
  CUST-DEL-001  scheduled    Primary Steel Frame - columns & rafters    (2026-08-10)
  CUST-DEL-004  confirmed    Full structural package - office frame      (2026-08-20)

Mock data (past): 1 delivery
  CUST-DEL-003  delivered  Foundation anchor bolts and base plates (2026-06-15)
  Carrier: Abc Carrier pvt ltd.

Single delivery detail ("Next Delivery" card). Same shape as a Get Deliveries list item, including loadAndBundle{loadId, bundleCount, truckNumber, totalWeight}.

Run 'Get Upcoming Deliveries' first to populate {{deliveryId}}.

Returns: { name, phone } for the driver on the carrier assigned to this delivery.

Returns 404 if no carrier has been selected yet or no phone is on file.

Returns: { name, phone, email } for the delivery/carrier company assigned to this delivery.

Returns 404 if no carrier has been selected yet.

Sends a delivery confirmation email to the logged-in customer's own email address.

Returns: { message, sentTo }

Downloads a .ics calendar file for this delivery (Content-Type: text/calendar).

Returns 400 if the delivery has no deliveryDate set yet.

In Postman, use 'Send and Download' to save the file.

note is optional. Emails the project's assigned salesperson (if any) with the customer's contact info and note.

Returns: { message }

Downloads a PDF summary of the delivery (Content-Type: application/pdf), covering delivery info, site contact, delivery company, and load & bundle summary.

In Postman, use 'Send and Download' to save the file.

Maps directly to the 4 Figma cards on the Invoices screen:

  totalProjectValue   → Total Project Value card  (sum of lead.quoteValue)
  pendingAmount       → Pending Amount card        (unpaid invoices total)
  amountPaid          → Amount Paid card           (paid invoices total)
  upcomingInvoiceDue  → Upcoming Invoice Due card  { _id, invoiceNumber, totalAmount, dueDate, status }

Also returns breakdown { totalInvoiced, paid, pending, overdue, invoiceCount }

Mock data:
  totalProjectValue : 250,000
  pendingAmount     : 9,250,000
  amountPaid        : 275,000
  upcomingInvoiceDue: INV-0010 (250,000 due 2026-06-13)
Returns: upcoming[], overdue[], paid[] — each has invoice details + dueDate + lead info

Returns invoices grouped by project, each group includes full lead details and per-project summary.

lead now includes: _id, jobId, projectName, buildingType, location, lifecycleStatus, quoteValue

summary per project: projectTotal, projectPaid, projectPending, overdueAmount, paidPercent, invoiceCount

Each invoice includes: dueDate (computed from date + daysToPay)

Mock data (PRO-001 warehouse - Texas):
  5 invoices | total: 9,525,000 | paid: 275,000 (3%) | pending: 9,250,000

Financial Summary card on project detail → payments tab.

Returns: { totalPayment, totalPaid, outstandingBalance }

totalPayment       — sum of all invoice totalAmount for this project
totalPaid          — sum of invoices with status 'paid'
outstandingBalance — totalPayment - totalPaid
Returns a pre-signed S3 URL for direct browser upload. PUT the file to the returned URL.
